name: Anura: a parasite
source: A suicidal young man crosses paths with an ambitious, eccentric woman. Hale-Bopp metastasizes upon the belly of night. She wants to build a machine to escape the world, he wants to heal the world to escape the machine. But in the end, we all gotta eat. [from [url=https://cancrizans.itch.io/anura]itch.io[/url]]
translation: 一名一心寻死的青年，与一位野心勃勃的古怪女子狭路相逢。海尔·波普彗星在黑夜的腹地悄然扩散蔓延。她想建造一台机器逃离这个世界，他却想治愈这个世界以逃离那台机器。但归根结底，大家总归都是要吃饭的。[摘自[url=https://cancrizans.itch.io/anura]itch.io[/url]]
